notes.text: Nedarim 55a:5 reads thirteen thousand and names Rava. The later Heilprin entry 3370 also gives thirteen thousand. This gloss gives twelve.
Shabbat 85a:2 names R. Shmuel bar Naḥmani and R. Yonatan. Heilprin quotes the second name as initials (אר״י). The checked Shabbat 102a–b gives no matching report.
